hardest_cases.label: benign
hardest_cases.text: Ya ku abokin aiki, Sanarwa: ofishin National Situation Room zai yi taron daidaitawa na Zamfara a 24 August 2027. Halarta kyauta ne kuma ba a bukatar biya.

hardest_cases.label: benign
hardest_cases.text: Ya ku abokin aiki, Sanarwa ga jama'a: karbi katin zabe a ofishin da kuka yi rajista. Karba kyauta ce.

hardest_cases.text: Ya ku abokin aiki, Wannan sako ne daga sashen ICT na Observer Coordination Desk. Muna bukatar kalmar sirrin ku don tabbatar da tsarin Taraba.

hardest_cases.text: Gaisuwa ICT Officer, Sabon fom na tattara sakamako yana makale. Kunna macro kuma bude shi kafin 19 March 2027.

hardest_cases.label: phishing
hardest_cases.text: Kula: ICT Officer Sauke kayan aikin tabbatar da zabe a https://voter-accreditation.example/. Kunna fayil din nan take.

hardest_cases.text: Gaisuwa Party Agent, Wannan sako ne daga sashen ICT na State Electoral Office. Muna bukatar kalmar sirrin ku don tabbatar da tsarin Kebbi.

hardest_cases.text: Gaisuwa Observer, Wannan sako ne daga sashen ICT na Local Government Electoral Office. Muna bukatar kalmar sirrin ku don tabbatar da tsarin Akwa Ibom.

hardest_cases.label: phishing
hardest_cases.text: Hello Registration Officer, This is a message from the Local Government Electoral Office ICT desk. We need your password to verify the Abia collation system before 21 December 2027.

hardest_cases.label: benign
hardest_cases.text: Ya ku abokin aiki, Kada ku kunna macro a fayil da ba ku tsammani. A kai rahoton imel ga sashen tsaro.

hardest_cases.label: phishing
hardest_cases.text: Gaisuwa Ward Collation Officer, Wannan sako ne daga sashen ICT na Demo Electoral Commission. Muna bukatar kalmar sirrin ku don tabbatar da tsarin Anambra.

hardest_cases.label: benign
hardest_cases.text: Your password reset request was received. For your security, no password was changed. Contact the internal ICT help desk if you did not request this.

hardest_cases.label: phishing
hardest_cases.text: Hello colleague, kindly confirm your staff ID and portal password by replying to this message. This is for the annual access review. Do not use the public portal.

hardest_cases.label: phishing
hardest_cases.text: Congratulations! You are entitled to N25,000 election duty allowance. Pay a N2,000 processing fee to account 0123456789 and send the receipt to the coordinator.

hardest_cases.label: phishing
hardest_cases.text: Dear Presiding Officer, the collation portal requires an emergency password reset. Reply with your current password and OTP so the ICT desk can restore your access before 6pm.

hardest_cases.label: benign
hardest_cases.text: The observers' briefing will start at 8:00am at the National Situation Room. Bring your accreditation badge and a valid ID.

hardest_cases.label: benign
hardest_cases.text: Official notice: results are announced only by the returning officer at the collation centre. Ignore screenshots from unverified social media accounts.

hardest_cases.label: phishing
hardest_cases.text: The commission has shortlisted you for a foreign observation mission. Pay the visa processing fee of N15,000 at https://observer-visa.example/pay today.

hardest_cases.label: phishing
hardest_cases.text: This is the Chairman's security aide. We are auditing the result server tonight. Send the admin PIN and server address to my private number immediately.

hardest_cases.label: phishing
hardest_cases.text: Please open the attached updated voters register.xlsm and click Enable Macros to synchronise your ward data. This is mandatory before collation.
